name: light-orm-monorepo
description: Lightweight TypeScript ORM for Serverless SQL Databases with Todo Showcase

scripts.build:api: tsup serverless/index.ts --format esm --out-dir api --external express --external cors --external pg && node scripts/generate-api-handlers.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run build:api && node -e "fs.cpSync('apps/todo-app/dist', 'dist', { recursive: true })"
